item.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 JSON Schema、工具调用或决策模型获取任意 LLM 的结构化输出 / How to Get Structured Output from Any LLM: JSON Schema, Tool Calls, or a Decision Model
item.description: When your code reads fields from a model's reply, like an order ID or a refund amount, it expects clean JSON every time. Most of the time, it gets it. But now and then the model wraps the JSON in a code fence, adds a field you didn't ask for, or sends a number as text, and your code breaks. If you use several models, one fix won't cover them all, because each model and provider handles structured output in its own way.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: Anthropic 再次修订 S-1：宣布已达责任扩展政策能力阈值，IPO 定价 $70-$78 / Anthropic again amended its S-1 today.
item.description: Anthropic 再次修订 IPO 申请文件 S-1（Amendment No. 2），宣布已越过其 Responsible Scaling Policy 设定的阈值，即 AI 正大幅加快 AI 研究速度、需更强安全检查。这一判断基于其对未来模型的预期而非现有模型的表现，一周前的文件还只说"可能即将"越过。文件同时将 IPO 发行价定为每股 $70 至 $78。（X：Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai)）
